title: Add a menuSelect widget
body:
**Do you want to request a *feature* or report a *bug*?**
feature

**Feature: What is your use case for such a feature?**
Redering a Menu as a select has been asked too many times to be ignored anymore. We need a menuSelect no matter how far we go in providing advanced rendering customisation.

**Feature: What is your proposed API entry? The new option to add? What is the behavior?**

```js
search.addWidget(instantsearch.widgets.menuSelect({
  attributeName: '...',
  limit: ...
  label: '...'
}));
```

This should render:

```html
<label>... <select><option></option></select></label>
```

Ref: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/868

**What project are you opening an issue for?**

* instantsearch.js

**What is the version you are using? Always use the latest one before opening a bug issue.**
latest
